Registers new IMAP account to be synced<br/><br/>Credentials are not verified while handling this request. The account connects afterwards, and an authentication failure surfaces as an authenticationError state rather than an error here. Use the account verification endpoint to test credentials up front.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
>
</Heading>
